# MediaFlow Studio 1.2.3 — AI upscaling for images

## ✨ What's new

### 🖼️ AI Enhance now takes images
- Drop **photos, screenshots, logos or artwork** (PNG, JPG, WebP) into **AI Enhance** to increase their resolution with **Real-ESRGAN**.
- Pick the zoom: **×2, ×3 or ×4** — a 1000 × 750 photo becomes up to 4000 × 3000.
- *Fast* model for drawings, screenshots and everyday images; *Best quality* for the cleanest detail on real photos.
- The result keeps the **original format** and **transparency** (PNG / WebP): `photo Upscaled.jpg`, `logo Upscaled.png`.
- Mix videos and images in the same queue: images get **Upscaling**, videos keep both modes (Upscaling and Interpolation).
- Runs **100% locally** on your graphics card, in a second or two per image.
- Very large images get a clear message if the result would exceed 16,383 px (choose ×2 or ×3 instead).

Already on 1.2.x? The app offers this update automatically — click **Update**, then **Restart & Install**.
